name: VibeCoder — AI-Powered Cloud Browser IDE
tagline: Full-featured browser IDE with AI assistant, live collaboration, and cloud execution
purpose: A cloud-based browser IDE that lets developers write, run, and debug code directly in the browser with an integrated AI assistant for code generation, explanation, and debugging.
problem_solved: Setting up local development environments is slow and machine-dependent. VibeCoder eliminates setup friction — developers get a full IDE in the browser in seconds, with AI assistance built-in.

architecture.description: Browser-based IDE with Monaco editor (same as VS Code), WebSocket-based real-time sync, sandboxed Docker containers for safe code execution, and Gemini AI for intelligent code assistance.
key_design_choices: Monaco Editor for VS Code-quality editing experience in browser
Docker sandboxing for safe arbitrary code execution
WebSocket for real-time collaboration and instant feedback
Gemini AI for contextual code understanding and generation

key_achievements: Full Monaco Editor integration (same engine as VS Code)
Sandboxed Docker code execution for 10+ programming languages
Real-time AI code assistant powered by Gemini
Multi-file project support with persistent cloud storage

engineering_decisions.reason: Monaco is the same editor engine powering VS Code. It provides better language intelligence, multi-cursor support, and developer familiarity. CodeMirror is lighter but less feature-complete for a full IDE experience.

Running arbitrary user code requires strict sandboxing. Docker provides container-level isolation — each execution gets a fresh container with resource limits. This prevents malicious code from affecting the host system.

engineering_decisions.decision: Why Gemini AI for the assistant?
engineering_decisions.reason: Gemini has strong code understanding and large context window. For IDE use cases — explaining code, generating functions, debugging — Gemini's code comprehension is excellent and the free tier supports development workloads.

challenges: Preventing container escape in Docker sandboxed execution — solved with read-only filesystems and network isolation
Latency in code execution feedback loop — optimized with container pre-warming
Monaco Editor performance with large files — solved with virtual rendering and lazy loading
